claim: In the Amazon EFS console, Quick create uses recommended settings that include lifecycle policies to transition the file system to EFS Infrequent Access (IA) storage after 30 days, to EFS Archive storage after 90 days, and not to transition to EFS Standard storage.

evidence.quote: Lifecycle policies to transition the file system to EFS Infrequent Access (IA) storage after 30 days, to EFS Archive storage after 90 days, and not to transition to EFS Standard storage
You can use Quick create to quickly create a file system with the following recommended settings.
